tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

The project's current recorded decision is to use Semantic Versioning (Semver) for release versions, in the major.minor.patch form: major increments signal breaking changes, minor increments signal feature additions, and patch increments signal bug fixes. The rationale on record is that API compatibility and clear backward-compatibility signaling for downstream consumers take priority over embedding release dates in version strings.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
